Platforms

Ideas you can learn with.

Six learning platforms turn research questions into experiences for children, students, educators, and writers.

The platform portfolio

Designed around learning—not novelty.

Each platform occupies a different place in the learning ecosystem. Together they connect storytelling, science, computational thinking, inquiry, writing, and AI literacy.

01 / EARLY SCIENCE

Science Adventures of Luna and Leo

A learning platform within the lab’s science and early-learning portfolios, designed for children in TK–2.

See related projects →
02 / LITERACY

My Story Detective

A K–2 platform connecting story exploration with the lab’s language, literacy, and early-learning work.

See related projects →
03 / CREATIVE CODING

CreatiCode

A platform in the lab’s portfolio for creative engagement with coding and computational ideas.

See computer science projects →
04 / AI + CODING

Agentic Coding Studio

A learning environment connected to the lab’s research on learner-directed AI in informal STEM learning.

See related projects →
05 / SCIENCE INQUIRY

Science Inquiry Studio

A platform within the science portfolio supporting inquiry-centered learning experiences.

See science projects →
06 / WRITING + AI

PapyrusAI

A guided generative AI environment designed to support writing development and AI literacy through structured interactions.

Visit PapyrusAI →
